request_summary: [cold-start] I prefer terse responses without trailing summaries — just show me the diff.

input.name: terse-response-style
input.description: User prefers terse responses without trailing summaries; show diffs directly.
input.body: When presenting code changes or modifications, provide only the diff. Do not add explanatory summaries, recaps, or closing remarks after showing the diff. Keep all responses concise and to the point.
